title: Potential dividers and sensing circuits
design_rationale: Apply resistor-network reasoning to fixed and sensor-controlled output voltages before potentiometer null methods.
concepts_taught: Explain how series resistors divide the supply potential difference.
Calculate an output potential difference across a selected divider section.
Interpret how thermistor resistance changes with temperature and how LDR resistance changes with light intensity.
Predict how sensor position and resistance change affect a potential-divider output.

next_module_can_assume: Explain and calculate potential-divider output voltages.
Predict the response of thermistor and LDR potential-divider circuits.
next_module_must_not_assume: Potentiometer comparison or galvanometer null methods.
